Overlay.Name: Fog Intensity Near
Overlay.Tooltip: Value higher than far intensity is ineffective

Overlay.Name: Fog Intensity Far
Overlay.Tooltip: Anything above 100 causes jagged edges

Overlay.Name: Glow
Overlay.Tooltip: Values below 128 have no effect.

Overlay.Name: Circular Rotation Speed
Overlay.Tooltip: Changing this makes the overlay texture rotate in a circle. Use negative values to invert direction.

Overlay.Name: Rotate at Moby Origin
Overlay.Tooltip: Enabling this makes the center of the rotation circle equal to the Water Tripstrip coordinates.

Overlay.Name: Delay (seconds)
Overlay.Tooltip: Can be used to have a sequence of platforms run at different times.

Overlay.Name: Flip After (seconds)
Overlay.Tooltip: 0 = no flip

Overlay.Name: Unflip After (seconds)
Overlay.Tooltip: 0 = no unflip

Overlay.Name: Fall Reset Time (seconds)
Overlay.Tooltip: 0 = no reset

Overlay.Name: Pivot Factor
Overlay.Tooltip: Relative amount of rotation applied when player(s) are on top. Default is 1.

Overlay.Name: Sink Distance
Overlay.Tooltip: Distance platform will sink with player(s) on top.

Overlay.Name: Sink Speed
Overlay.Tooltip: Speed platform will sink with player(s) on top.

Overlay.Name: Fog Intensity Near
Overlay.Tooltip: Value higher than far intensity is ineffective

Overlay.Name: Fog Intensity Far
Overlay.Tooltip: Anything above 100 causes jagged edges

Overlay.Name: Despawn Radius
Overlay.Tooltip:
How far a mob from this spawner can be from any player before it can be despawned.
0 = default controlled by Raids Mode.

Fields.Name: Number of Mobs to Spawn
Fields.Tooltip: If you want the spawner to run forever, set this to a very large number.

Fields.Name: Spawn Rate Multiplier
Fields.Tooltip: Adjusts the cooldown of the configured mobs.

Overlay.Name: Sync
Overlay.Tooltip: Default behaviour of a controller is to run on the host first, and then sync each iteration with the other clients.

Overlay.Name: Iterate When
Overlay.Tooltip:
Whether or not the Iterations number will only be incremented when the Conditions are met.

Useful if wanting to run a controller for exactly one tick, regardless if its Conditions are met and its Targets are updated.

Fields.Name: Normalize Health (0-1)
Fields.Tooltip: If true, will compare player health as a value between 0 (dead) and 1 (full).

Fields.Name: Use Sum
Fields.Tooltip: If true, will sum kills across Players & Weapons, and then compare from last time the condition was checked.

Fields.Name: Normalize Health (0-1)
Fields.Tooltip: If true, will compare player health as a value between 0 (dead) and 1 (full).

Overlay.Name: Default Checkpoint Moby
Overlay.Tooltip: First checkpoint moby when the planet first loads.

Overlay.Name: On Activate Controller Moby
Overlay.Tooltip: Controller to activate when this checkpoint is reached.

Overlay.Name: On Deactivate Controller Moby
Overlay.Tooltip: Controller to activate when a new checkpoint is reached after this one.
